name: otel-png
description: Render OpenTelemetry traces as PNG pages. Pure JS, zero dependencies.

scripts.typecheck: node --check otel-png-cf.mjs && node --check worker-bench/worker.mjs && node --check worker-bench/app-helpers.mjs && node --check worker-bench/profile-artifacts.mjs && node --check pprof-render/tools/cpuprofile-to-pprof.mjs && node --check tools/cf-capture.mjs && node --check tools/smoke.mjs
scripts.check:core: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.check: npm run check:core && npm run smoke:local
scripts.deploy: cd worker-bench && env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN npx --no-install wrangler deploy
